mapper.select: SELECT 0 as purchase_pending, 0 as sales_pending, 0 as prod_pending, 0 as crm_pending, 0 as sfa_pending, 75 as sales_goal_rate

SELECT seq as id, category as media_type, DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%H:%i') as time_str, content FROM DASHBOARD_LIVE_FEED WHERE UPPER(cmpycd) = UPPER(#{cmpycd}) AND useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY addtime DESC, seq DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT boardid as id, subject as title, DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m-%d') as date FROM BOAD001T_TBL WHERE UPPER(cmpycd) = UPPER(#{cmpycd}) AND fancode = '010' ORDER BY addtime DESC, boardid DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT category, title, expire_date as date, amount as amt, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(expire_date, NOW()) <= 3 THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'normal' END as urgency FROM DASHBOARD_EXPIRY_MANAGE WHERE UPPER(cmpycd) = UPPER(#{cmpycd}) AND useyn = 'Y' AND expire_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY expire_date ASC LIMIT 5
